usage: music-tagger write-ratings [-h] [--from FROM_FILE] [--root ROOT]
                                  [--dry-run] [--log LOG | --no-log]

Write rating tags to audio files from a ratings JSON. Favorites are not
written.

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --from FROM_FILE  Ratings JSON (default:
                    /mnt/synology/media/music/ratings.json).
  --root ROOT       Library root to resolve paths (default:
                    /mnt/synology/media/music).
  --dry-run         Show what would change without writing.
  --log LOG         Append changes to this log file (default:
                    $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                    tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log          Do not write the change log.
